47	    let r2 = dot(r, r) + ${SOFTENING_EPSILON * SOFTENING_EPSILON};
48	    let dist_sq = dot(r, r);
49	    let dist = sqrt(dist_sq);
50	    let aMag = params.G * bodyIn[j].mass / r2;
51	    let closeThresh = (b.radius + bodyIn[j].radius) * 3.0;
52	    let tidalFactor = select(1.0, 1.0 + 0.3 * (1.0 - dist / max(closeThresh, 0.001)), dist < closeThresh);
53	    acc += r * ((aMag / sqrt(r2)) * tidalFactor);
54	  }
55	
56	  b.vel += acc * params.dt;
57	  b.pos += b.vel * params.dt;
58	  bodyOut[i] = b;
59	}
60	`;
61	
62	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
63	// Helpers
64	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
65	
66	/** Write a single BodyData into a DataView at the given byte offset. */
67	function writeBody(view: DataView, byteOffset: number, b: BodyData): void {
68	  view.setFloat32(byteOffset + 0,  b.pos[0],  true);
69	  view.setFloat32(byteOffset + 4,  b.pos[1],  true);
70	  view.setFloat32(byteOffset + 8,  b.vel[0],  true);
71	  view.setFloat32(byteOffset + 12, b.vel[1],  true);
72	  view.setFloat32(byteOffset + 16, b.mass,    true);
73	  view.setFloat32(byteOffset + 20, b.radius,  true);
74	  view.setFloat32(byteOffset + 24, 0,         true); // _pad0
75	  view.setFloat32(byteOffset + 28, 0,         true); // _pad1
76	}
77	
78	/** Read a single BodyData from a DataView at the given byte offset. */
79	function readBody(view: DataView, byteOffset: number): BodyData {
80	  return {
81	    pos:    [view.getFloat32(byteOffset + 0,  true), view.getFloat32(byteOffset + 4,  true)],
82	    vel:    [view.getFloat32(byteOffset + 8,  true), view.getFloat32(byteOffset + 12, true)],
83	    mass:   view.getFloat32(byteOffset + 16, true),
84	    radius: view.getFloat32(byteOffset + 20, true),
85	  };
86	}
87	
88	/**
89	 * Compute net acceleration on body `i` from all other bodies (CPU, O(N²)).
90	 * Uses the same softening as the GPU shader.
91	 */
92	function cpuAcceleration(bodies: BodyData[], i: number): [number, number] {
93	  let ax = 0;
94	  let ay = 0;
95	  const bi = bodies[i];
96	  for (let j = 0; j < bodies.length; j++) {
97	    if (j === i) continue;
98	    const bj = bodies[j];
99	    const dx = bj.pos[0] - bi.pos[0];
100	    const dy = bj.pos[1] - bi.pos[1];
101	    const r2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + SOFTENING_EPSILON * SOFTENING_EPSILON;
102	    const aMag = (G * bj.mass) / r2;
103	    const r = Math.sqrt(r2);
104	    ax += (aMag * dx) / r;
105	    ay += (aMag * dy) / r;
106	  }
107	  return [ax, ay];
108	}
109	
110	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
111	// PhysicsEngine
112	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
113	
114	export class PhysicsEngine {
115	  /** CPU mirror of body state (1-frame lag is acceptable). */
116	  cpuBodies: BodyData[] = [];
117	
118	  /** Current body count. */
119	  N: number = 0;
120	
121	  /** Fires when two bodies overlap. Set by main.ts. */
122	  onMerge: (i: number, j: number) => void = () => {};
123	
124	  // -- WebGPU objects --------------------------------------------------------
125	  private device: GPUDevice;
126	  private pipeline!: GPUComputePipeline;
127	  private bindGroupLayout!: GPUBindGroupLayout;
128	
129	  /** Ping-pong body buffers. */
130	  private bufA!: GPUBuffer;
131	  private bufB!: GPUBuffer;
132	
133	  /** Bind groups: bgAtoB reads A → writes B; bgBtoA reads B → writes A. */
134	  private bgAtoB!: GPUBindGroup;
135	  private bgBtoA!: GPUBindGroup;
136	
137	  /** Params uniform buffer (16 bytes). */
138	  private paramsBuffer!: GPUBuffer;
139	
140	  /** Staging buffer for CPU readback. */
141	  private stagingBuffer!: GPUBuffer;
142	
143	  /**
144	   * 0 = current source is A, output goes to B.
145	   * 1 = current source is B, output goes to A.
146	   */
147	  private pingIndex: number = 0;
148	
149	  /** True while a mapAsync is in-flight. */
150	  private mapPending: boolean = false;
151	
152	  /** Incremented by init/setBodies; lets mapAsync callbacks detect stale reads. */
153	  private generation: number = 0;
154	
155	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
156	
157	  constructor(device: GPUDevice) {
158	    this.device = device;
159	    this._buildPipeline();
160	  }
161	
162	  // -- Public API ------------------------------------------------------------
163	
164	  /**
165	   * Load initial bodies.  Backs velocities off by half a substep so the first
166	   * leapfrog step is correctly offset (prevents energy drift on startup).
167	   */
168	  init(bodies: BodyData[]): void {
169	    if (bodies.length > MAX_BODIES) {
170	      throw new Error(`Too many bodies: ${bodies.length} > MAX_BODIES (${MAX_BODIES})`);
171	    }
172	
173	    // Deep-copy so we don't mutate the caller's array.
174	    const adjusted: BodyData[] = bodies.map((b) => ({
175	      pos:    [b.pos[0],  b.pos[1]]  as [number, number],
176	      vel:    [b.vel[0],  b.vel[1]]  as [number, number],
177	      mass:   b.mass,
178	      radius: b.radius,
179	    }));
180	
181	    // Half-step velocity back-initialisation.
182	    const dtSub = DT / SUBSTEP_COUNT;
183	    const halfDt = dtSub * 0.5;
184	    for (let i = 0; i < adjusted.length; i++) {
185	      const [ax, ay] = cpuAcceleration(adjusted, i);
186	      adjusted[i].vel[0] -= ax * halfDt;
187	      adjusted[i].vel[1] -= ay * halfDt;
188	    }
189	
190	    this.N = adjusted.length;
191	    this.cpuBodies = adjusted;
192	    this.pingIndex = 0;
193	    this.generation++;
194	    this._uploadBothBuffers(adjusted);
195	  }
196	
197	  /**
198	   * Run SUBSTEP_COUNT compute dispatches for a single frame.
199	   * Returns the last written GPU buffer (ready for use as vertex/copy source).
200	   */
201	  tick(dt: number): GPUBuffer {
202	    const dtSub = dt / SUBSTEP_COUNT;
203	    const encoder = this.device.createCommandEncoder();
204	
205	    for (let s = 0; s < SUBSTEP_COUNT; s++) {
206	      // Update params uniform for this substep.
207	      const paramData = new ArrayBuffer(16);
208	      const paramView = new DataView(paramData);
209	      paramView.setUint32(0,  this.N,   true);
210	      paramView.setFloat32(4, dtSub,    true);
211	      paramView.setFloat32(8, G,        true);
212	      paramView.setFloat32(12, 0,       true); // _pad
213	      this.device.queue.writeBuffer(this.paramsBuffer, 0, paramData);
214	
215	      const pass = encoder.beginComputePass();
216	      pass.setPipeline(this.pipeline);
217	      pass.setBindGroup(0, this.pingIndex === 0 ? this.bgAtoB : this.bgBtoA);
218	      pass.dispatchWorkgroups(Math.max(this.N, 1), 1, 1);
219	      pass.end();
220	
221	      this.pingIndex ^= 1; // swap
222	    }
223	
224	    this.device.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
225	
226	    // After SUBSTEP_COUNT swaps the output buffer is:
227	    //   even SUBSTEP_COUNT → same parity as start → bufB (if we started at 0→B)
228	    // More precisely: pingIndex after all swaps tells us which buffer is the SOURCE
229	    // for the NEXT tick, so the last WRITTEN buffer is the one that was output last.
230	    //
231	    // After one swap pingIndex = 1 → source is now B → last write was to B.
232	    // After two swaps pingIndex = 0 → source is now A → last write was to A.
233	    // In general: last written = (pingIndex === 0) ? bufA : bufB
234	    //   because pingIndex was flipped past the last write.
235	    return this.pingIndex === 0 ? this.bufA : this.bufB;
236	  }
237	
238	  /**
239	   * Schedule an async CPU readback of the current output buffer.
240	   * Skipped (no-op) if a readback is already in-flight.
241	   * After reading, runs collision detection and calls onMerge for overlapping pairs.
242	   */
243	  scheduleCpuRead(callback: (bodies: BodyData[]) => void): void {
244	    if (this.mapPending) return;
245	
246	    // The last written buffer is the same as tick()'s return value.
247	    const srcBuffer = this.pingIndex === 0 ? this.bufA : this.bufB;
248	    const byteLen = this.N * BODY_STRIDE;
249	    if (byteLen === 0) return;
250	
251	    const encoder = this.device.createCommandEncoder();
252	    encoder.copyBufferToBuffer(srcBuffer, 0, this.stagingBuffer, 0, byteLen);
253	    this.device.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
254	
255	    this.mapPending = true;
256	    const n = this.N;
257	    const gen = this.generation;
258	
259	    this.stagingBuffer.mapAsync(GPUMapMode.READ, 0, byteLen).then(() => {
260	      const mapped = this.stagingBuffer.getMappedRange(0, byteLen);
261	      const view   = new DataView(mapped);
262	      const bodies: BodyData[] = [];
263	      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
264	        bodies.push(readBody(view, i * BODY_STRIDE));
265	      }
266	      this.stagingBuffer.unmap();
267	      this.mapPending = false;
268	
269	      // Discard if init/setBodies ran while this read was in-flight.
270	      if (gen !== this.generation) return;
271	
272	      this.cpuBodies = bodies;
273	      callback(bodies);
274	      this._checkCollisions(bodies);
275	    }).catch(() => {
276	      this.mapPending = false;
277	    });
278	  }
279	
280	  /**
281	   * Write a new body array to BOTH GPU buffers and reset pingIndex.
282	   * Use after add / remove / reset operations.
283	   */
284	  setBodies(bodies: BodyData[]): void {
285	    if (bodies.length > MAX_BODIES) {
286	      throw new Error(`Too many bodies: ${bodies.length} > MAX_BODIES (${MAX_BODIES})`);
287	    }
288	    this.N = bodies.length;
289	    this.cpuBodies = bodies.map((b) => ({ ...b, pos: [...b.pos] as [number, number], vel: [...b.vel] as [number, number] }));
290	    this.pingIndex = 0;
291	    this.generation++;
292	    this._uploadBothBuffers(bodies);
293	  }
294	
295	  destroy(): void {
296	    this.bufA.destroy();
297	    this.bufB.destroy();
298	    this.paramsBuffer.destroy();
299	    this.stagingBuffer.destroy();
300	  }
301	
302	  // -- Private helpers -------------------------------------------------------
303	
304	  private _buildPipeline(): void {
305	    const device = this.device;
306	    const bufferSize = MAX_BODIES * BODY_STRIDE;
307	
308	    // Body buffers (ping-pong)
309	    const bufUsage = GPUBufferUsage.STORAGE | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_SRC | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST;
310	    this.bufA = device.createBuffer({ size: bufferSize, usage: bufUsage });
311	    this.bufB = device.createBuffer({ size: bufferSize, usage: bufUsage });
312	
313	    // Params uniform buffer
314	    this.paramsBuffer = device.createBuffer({
315	      size:  16,
316	      usage: GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST,
317	    });
318	
319	    // Staging buffer for CPU readback
320	    this.stagingBuffer = device.createBuffer({
321	      size:  bufferSize,
322	      usage: GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST | GPUBufferUsage.MAP_READ,
323	    });
324	
325	    // Shader module
326	    const shaderModule = device.createShaderModule({ code: COMPUTE_SHADER });
327	
328	    // Bind group layout
329	    this.bindGroupLayout = device.createBindGroupLayout({
330	      entries: [
331	        { binding: 0, visibility: GPUShaderStage.COMPUTE, buffer: { type: "read-only-storage" } },
332	        { binding: 1, visibility: GPUShaderStage.COMPUTE, buffer: { type: "storage"           } },
333	        { binding: 2, visibility: GPUShaderStage.COMPUTE, buffer: { type: "uniform"            } },
334	      ],
335	    });
336	
337	    // Pipeline
338	    this.pipeline = device.createComputePipeline({
339	      layout: device.createPipelineLayout({ bindGroupLayouts: [this.bindGroupLayout] }),
340	      compute: { module: shaderModule, entryPoint: "main" },
341	    });
342	
343	    // Bind groups
344	    this.bgAtoB = this._makeBindGroup(this.bufA, this.bufB);
345	    this.bgBtoA = this._makeBindGroup(this.bufB, this.bufA);
346	  }
347	
348	  private _makeBindGroup(src: GPUBuffer, dst: GPUBuffer): GPUBindGroup {
349	    return this.device.createBindGroup({
350	      layout: this.bindGroupLayout,
351	      entries: [
352	        { binding: 0, resource: { buffer: src               } },
353	        { binding: 1, resource: { buffer: dst               } },
354	        { binding: 2, resource: { buffer: this.paramsBuffer } },
355	      ],
356	    });
357	  }
358	
359	  private _uploadBothBuffers(bodies: BodyData[]): void {
360	    const arrayBuf = new ArrayBuffer(MAX_BODIES * BODY_STRIDE);
361	    const view     = new DataView(arrayBuf);
362	    for (let i = 0; i < bodies.length; i++) {
363	      writeBody(view, i * BODY_STRIDE, bodies[i]);
364	    }
365	    this.device.queue.writeBuffer(this.bufA, 0, arrayBuf);
366	    this.device.queue.writeBuffer(this.bufB, 0, arrayBuf);
367	  }
368	
369	  private _checkCollisions(bodies: BodyData[]): void {
370	    for (let i = 0; i < bodies.length; i++) {
371	      for (let j = i + 1; j < bodies.length; j++) {
372	        const bi = bodies[i];
373	        const bj = bodies[j];
374	        const dx   = bj.pos[0] - bi.pos[0];
375	        const dy   = bj.pos[1] - bi.pos[1];
376	        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
377	        if (dist < (bi.radius + bj.radius) * COLLISION_OVERLAP) {
378	          this.onMerge(i, j);
379	          // One merge per readback frame — indices invalidated after merge, stop.
380	          return;
381	        }
382	      }
383	    }
384	  }
385	}
386

6	export function predictOrbit(idx: number, bodies: BodyData[]): Point2D[] {
7	  if (bodies.length < 2) return [];
8	  const body = bodies[idx];
9	
10	  // Find dominant attractor
11	  let maxForce = 0;
12	  let secondForce = 0;
13	  let attractorIdx = -1;
14	
15	  for (let j = 0; j < bodies.length; j++) {
16	    if (j === idx) continue;
17	    const bj = bodies[j];
18	    const dx = bj.pos[0] - body.pos[0];
19	    const dy = bj.pos[1] - body.pos[1];
20	    const r2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + SOFTENING_EPSILON * SOFTENING_EPSILON;
21	    const force = G * bj.mass / r2;
22	    if (force > maxForce) {
23	      secondForce = maxForce;
24	      maxForce = force;
25	      attractorIdx = j;
26	    } else if (force > secondForce) {
27	      secondForce = force;
28	    }
29	  }
30	
31	  // Use Kepler if dominant attractor is 10× stronger or only one other body
32	  const useKepler = bodies.length === 2 || (secondForce > 0 && maxForce / secondForce > 10);
33	
34	  if (useKepler && attractorIdx >= 0) {
35	    return keplerPath(body, bodies[attractorIdx]);
36	  }
37	
38	  return numericalPath(idx, bodies);
39	}

41	function keplerPath(body: BodyData, attractor: BodyData): Point2D[] {
42	  // Relative position and velocity
43	  const rx = body.pos[0] - attractor.pos[0];
44	  const ry = body.pos[1] - attractor.pos[1];
45	  const vx = body.vel[0] - attractor.vel[0];
46	  const vy = body.vel[1] - attractor.vel[1];
47	
48	  const r = Math.sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry);
49	  if (r < 1e-10) return [];
50	
51	  const v2 = vx * vx + vy * vy;
52	  const mu = G * (body.mass + attractor.mass);
53	
54	  // Specific orbital energy
55	  const eps = v2 / 2 - mu / r;
56	
57	  // Specific angular momentum (scalar, signed)
58	  const h = rx * vy - ry * vx;
59	
60	  // Near-radial trajectory guard
61	  if (Math.abs(h) < 1e-8) return [];
62	
63	  // Eccentricity
64	  const e = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 + (2 * eps * h * h) / (mu * mu)));
65	
66	  // Eccentricity vector (periapsis direction)
67	  const rdotv = rx * vx + ry * vy;
68	  const evx = ((v2 - mu / r) * rx - rdotv * vx) / mu;
69	  const evy = ((v2 - mu / r) * ry - rdotv * vy) / mu;
70	  const eAngle = Math.atan2(evy, evx);
71	
72	  const points: Point2D[] = [];
73	
74	  if (eps < 0) {
75	    // Elliptic orbit
76	    const a = -mu / (2 * eps);
77	    const p = a * (1 - e * e);
78	    const count = 180;
79	    for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
80	      const theta = (k / count) * 2 * Math.PI;
81	      const denom = 1 + e * Math.cos(theta);
82	      if (Math.abs(denom) < 1e-10) continue;
83	      const rk = p / denom;
84	      const angle = theta + eAngle;
85	      const wx = attractor.pos[0] + rk * Math.cos(angle);
86	      const wy = attractor.pos[1] + rk * Math.sin(angle);
87	      points.push([wx, wy]);
88	    }
89	  } else {
90	    // Hyperbolic trajectory
91	    if (e <= 1) return [];
92	    const a = mu / (2 * Math.abs(eps));
93	    const p = a * (e * e - 1);
94	    const thetaMax = Math.acos(-1 / e) - 0.02;
95	    const count = 120;
96	    for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
97	      const theta = -thetaMax + (k / (count - 1)) * 2 * thetaMax;
98	      const denom = 1 + e * Math.cos(theta);
99	      if (denom < 1e-10) continue;
100	      const rk = p / denom;
101	      const angle = theta + eAngle;
102	      const wx = attractor.pos[0] + rk * Math.cos(angle);
103	      const wy = attractor.pos[1] + rk * Math.sin(angle);
104	      points.push([wx, wy]);
105	    }
106	  }
107	
108	  return points;
109	}
110	
111	function numericalPath(idx: number, bodies: BodyData[]): Point2D[] {
112	  const n = bodies.length;
113	  const posX = new Float64Array(n);
114	  const posY = new Float64Array(n);
115	  const velX = new Float64Array(n);
116	  const velY = new Float64Array(n);
117	
118	  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
119	    posX[i] = bodies[i].pos[0];
120	    posY[i] = bodies[i].pos[1];
121	    velX[i] = bodies[i].vel[0];
122	    velY[i] = bodies[i].vel[1];
123	  }
124	
125	  const dt = DT * 4;
126	  const totalSteps = 300;
127	  const recordEvery = 5;
128	  const points: Point2D[] = [];
129	
130	  for (let step = 0; step < totalSteps; step++) {
131	    // Euler integration for all bodies
132	    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
133	      let ax = 0;
134	      let ay = 0;
135	      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
136	        if (j === i) continue;
137	        const dx = posX[j] - posX[i];
138	        const dy = posY[j] - posY[i];
139	        const r2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + SOFTENING_EPSILON * SOFTENING_EPSILON;
140	        const aMag = G * bodies[j].mass / r2;
141	        const r = Math.sqrt(r2);
142	        ax += (aMag * dx) / r;
143	        ay += (aMag * dy) / r;
144	      }
145	      velX[i] += ax * dt;
146	      velY[i] += ay * dt;
147	    }
148	    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
149	      posX[i] += velX[i] * dt;
150	      posY[i] += velY[i] * dt;
151	    }
152	
153	    if (step % recordEvery === 0) {
154	      points.push([posX[idx], posY[idx]]);
155	    }
156	  }
157	
158	  return points;
159	}

109	        badge.className = 'tb-badge';
110	        badge.textContent = this._lagrangeBadge();
111	        btn.appendChild(badge);
112	        this.badgeEl = badge;
113	      }
114	
115	      btn.addEventListener('click', () => this._onClick(def, btn, tip));
116	      this.buttons.set(def.key, btn);
117	      this.container.appendChild(btn);
118	    }
119	  }
120	
121	  private _isActive(def: ButtonDef): boolean {
122	    if (def.isLagrange) return this.flags.lagrangePoints;
123	    return this.flags[def.key] as boolean;
124	  }
125	
126	  private _lagrangeLabel(): string {
127	    if (!this.flags.lagrangePoints) return ' (off)';
128	    if (this.flags.lagrangeCount === 5) return ' (L1–L5)';
129	    if (this.flags.lagrangeCount === 2) return ' (L4+L5)';
130	    return ' (off)';
131	  }
132	
133	  private _lagrangeBadge(): string {
134	    if (!this.flags.lagrangePoints) return 'L0';
135	    if (this.flags.lagrangeCount === 5) return 'L5';
136	    if (this.flags.lagrangeCount === 2) return 'L2';
137	    return 'L0';
138	  }
139	
140	  private _onClick(def: ButtonDef, btn: HTMLButtonElement, tip: HTMLSpanElement): void {
141	    if (def.isLagrange) {
142	      // Cycle: true/5 → true/2 → false → true/5
143	      if (this.flags.lagrangePoints && this.flags.lagrangeCount === 5) {
144	        this.flags.lagrangeCount = 2;
145	      } else if (this.flags.lagrangePoints && this.flags.lagrangeCount === 2) {
146	        this.flags.lagrangePoints = false;
147	      } else {
148	        this.flags.lagrangePoints = true;
149	        this.flags.lagrangeCount = 5;
150	      }
151	    } else {
152	      (this.flags as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[def.key] = !(this.flags[def.key] as boolean);
153	    }
154	
155	    btn.classList.toggle('active', this._isActive(def));
156	
157	    if (def.isLagrange && this.badgeEl) {
158	      this.badgeEl.textContent = this._lagrangeBadge();
159	      tip.textContent = def.tooltip + this._lagrangeLabel();
160	    }
161	
162	    this.onChange({ ...this.flags });
163	  }
164	
165	  destroy(): void {
166	    this.container.innerHTML = '';
167	  }
168	}
169	
```

periPt = pt; }\n        if (d > maxD) { maxD = d; apoPt = pt; }\n      }\n\n      // Only show when orbit is meaningfully eccentric (>2% variation)\n      if (maxD / Math.max(minD, 1) < 1.02) continue;\n\n      c.save();\n      c.font = `bold 12px 'Geist Mono', monospace`;\n      c.textBaseline = 'middle';\n      c.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.9)';\n      c.shadowBlur = 4;\n\n      // Periapsis \u2014 orange\n      const [psx, psy] = worldToScreen(periPt, camera, W, H);\n      c.beginPath();\n      c.arc(psx, psy, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n      c.fillStyle = '#FF8C00';\n      c.fill();\n      c.fillStyle = '#FF8C00';\n      c.textAlign = 'left';\n      c.fillText('Pe', psx + 6, psy);\n\n      // Apoapsis \u2014 cyan\n      const [asx, asy] = worldToScreen(apoPt, camera, W, H);\n      c.beginPath();\n      c.arc(asx, asy, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n      c.fillStyle = '#40A0FF';\n      c.fill();\n      c.fillStyle = '#40A0FF';\n      c.fillText('Ap', asx + 6, asy);\n\n      c.restore();\n    }\n  }"
}

  "new_string": "  private _drawPreview(temp: number, mass?: number): void {\n    const canvas = this.previewCanvas;\n    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');\n    if (!ctx) return;\n    const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;\n    const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;\n\n    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);\n\n    const rgb = temperatureToColor(temp);\n    const r   = mass ? Six sub-tasks in that message:
1. Sun should NOT be a black hole
2. Planets should be bigger (visually)
3. Labels/Lagrange/ap/pe: only show for SELECTED body (default: only show for Sun/largest)

---

2. Key Technical Concepts:

- **WebGPU N-body simulator** — compute shader ping-pong, leapfrog integration, Canvas 2D overlay
- **Schwarzschild radius bug** — `SCHWARZSCHILD_CONST = 2/(C_SIM^2)`, with `C_SIM=80` and Sun mass `1e6`: `0.0003125 * 1e6 = 312.5 > 80` (Sun radius cap) → Sun IS flagged as black hole. Fix: increase `C_SIM` to ~2000 (gives `SCHWARZSCHILD_CONST = 5e-7`, BH threshold mass = 160M, well above Sun's 1M)
- **Hill sphere constraint** — For Moon to orbit Earth stably: Earth's Hill sphere radius `r_Hill = r_earth * (M_earth/(3*M_sun))^(1/3)` must exceed Moon's orbital radius. With current Earth=400, Sun=1e6, Earth orbit=200: `r_Hill = 200*(400/3e6)^(1/3) = ~10.2`. Moon at r=25 is OUTSIDE Earth's Hill sphere → Moon orbits Sun, not Earth.
- **Kepler vs numerical orbit predictor** — `orbitPredictor.ts` uses Kepler when dominant attractor is 10× stronger than second strongest. Galilean moons: Jupiter force/Sun force ≈ 9.5× → BELOW threshold → numerical integration used → shows complex spiral instead of clean ellipse around parent. Fix: lower threshold to 4×–5× AND increase planet masses so planet genuinely dominates.
- **bodyRadius formula** — `Math.max(2, Math.min(80, Math.sqrt(mass) * 0.5))`. Cap at 80 means Sun (1e6) and Jupiter (80000) render at same size. Need to raise cap or modify formula.
- **Leapfrog integration** — WGSL shader uses symplectic Euler (kick-then-drift), with half-step back-initialization in `init()` making it equivalent to leapfrog
- **Tidal force in WGSL** — `closeThresh = (b.radius + bodyIn[j].radius) * 3.0`. With large planet radii, this threshold becomes huge and could affect distant bodies incorrectly
- **Elliptic orbit placement** — `bodyAtPerihelion(a, e, periAngle, centralMass, centralPos, centralVel, myMass)` — places body at perihelion using `r_p = a*(1-e)`, `v_p = sqrt(mu*(1+e)/r_p)`

5. Problem Solving:

**Moon orbit display**: The fundamental issue is the Hill sphere constraint. For moons to visually orbit their parents, the parent's gravitational force must exceed the Sun's force at the moon's location. This requires either very large planet masses or small moon orbital radii. The solution is a combination of:
1. Increase planet masses substantially (Earth ~25000, Jupiter ~80000)
2. Reduce moon orbital radii (Moon at r=8 instead of 25)
3. Lower Kepler dominance threshold in orbitPredictor from 10× to 4×

**Planet stability**: Current planet masses are too small relative to Sun, and tidal force WGSL enhancement can destabilize inner planets. The larger masses also improve the physics stability since they're more "real" relative to the Sun mass.

**Visual scale**: With bodyRadius cap=80, both Sun and Jupiter look the same size. Raising cap to 120 allows planets to differentiate. Sun stays at 80 (since sqrt(1e6)*0.5=500, still capped), but Jupiter (80000) gets radius=sqrt(80000)*0.5=141→120 (capped at 120 now), Saturn gets sqrt(30000)*0.5=86.6 (under new cap), etc.

30	/**
31	 * Place a body at its orbital perihelion.
32	 * periAngle = angle (radians) of the perihelion direction from +x axis.
33	 * retrograde = true reverses orbital direction (e.g. Triton).
34	 */
35	function bodyAtPerihelion(
36	  a: number,
37	  e: number,
38	  periAngle: number,
39	  centralMass: number,
40	  centralPos: [number, number],
41	  centralVel: [number, number],
42	  myMass: number,
43	  retrograde = false,
44	): BodyData {
45	  const mu  = G * centralMass;
46	  const r_p = a * (1 - e);
47	  const v_p = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, mu * (1 + e) / r_p));
48	  const ca  = Math.cos(periAngle);
49	  const sa  = Math.sin(periAngle);
50	  const px  = centralPos[0] + r_p * ca;
51	  const py  = centralPos[1] + r_p * sa;
52	  const vx  = retrograde ? centralVel[0] + v_p * sa : centralVel[0] - v_p * sa;
53	  const vy  = retrograde ? centralVel[1] - v_p * ca : centralVel[1] + v_p * ca;
54	  return { pos: [px, py], vel: [vx, vy], mass: myMass, radius: bodyRadius(myMass) };
55	}

6	export function predictOrbit(idx: number, bodies: BodyData[]): Point2D[] {
7	  if (bodies.length < 2) return [];
8	  const body = bodies[idx];
9	
10	  // Find dominant attractor
11	  let maxForce = 0;
12	  let secondForce = 0;
13	  let attractorIdx = -1;
14	
15	  for (let j = 0; j < bodies.length; j++) {
16	    if (j === idx) continue;
17	    const bj = bodies[j];
18	    const dx = bj.pos[0] - body.pos[0];
19	    const dy = bj.pos[1] - body.pos[1];
20	    const r2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + SOFTENING_EPSILON * SOFTENING_EPSILON;
21	    const force = G * bj.mass / r2;
22	    if (force > maxForce) {
23	      secondForce = maxForce;
24	      maxForce = force;
25	      attractorIdx = j;
26	    } else if (force > secondForce) {
27	      secondForce = force;
28	    }
29	  }
30	
31	  // Use Kepler if dominant attractor is 10× stronger or only one other body
32	  const useKepler = bodies.length === 2 || (secondForce > 0 && maxForce / secondForce > 10);
33	
34	  if (useKepler && attractorIdx >= 0) {
35	    return keplerPath(body, bodies[attractorIdx]);
36	  }
37	
38	  return numericalPath(idx, bodies);
39	}

41	function keplerPath(body: BodyData, attractor: BodyData): Point2D[] {
42	  // Relative position and velocity
43	  const rx = body.pos[0] - attractor.pos[0];
44	  const ry = body.pos[1] - attractor.pos[1];
45	  const vx = body.vel[0] - attractor.vel[0];
46	  const vy = body.vel[1] - attractor.vel[1];
47	
48	  const r = Math.sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry);
49	  if (r < 1e-10) return [];
50	
51	  const v2 = vx * vx + vy * vy;
52	  const mu = G * (body.mass + attractor.mass);
53	
54	  // Specific orbital energy
55	  const eps = v2 / 2 - mu / r;
56	
57	  // Specific angular momentum (scalar, signed)
58	  const h = rx * vy - ry * vx;
59	
60	  // Near-radial trajectory guard
61	  if (Math.abs(h) < 1e-8) return [];
62	
63	  // Eccentricity
64	  const e = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 + (2 * eps * h * h) / (mu * mu)));
65	
66	  // Eccentricity vector (periapsis direction)
67	  const rdotv = rx * vx + ry * vy;
68	  const evx = ((v2 - mu / r) * rx - rdotv * vx) / mu;
69	  const evy = ((v2 - mu / r) * ry - rdotv * vy) / mu;
70	  const eAngle = Math.atan2(evy, evx);
71	
72	  const points: Point2D[] = [];
73	
74	  if (eps < 0) {
75	    // Elliptic orbit
76	    const a = -mu / (2 * eps);
77	    const p = a * (1 - e * e);
78	    const count = 180;
79	    for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
80	      const theta = (k / count) * 2 * Math.PI;
81	      const denom = 1 + e * Math.cos(theta);
82	      if (Math.abs(denom) < 1e-10) continue;
83	      const rk = p / denom;
84	      const angle = theta + eAngle;
85	      const wx = attractor.pos[0] + rk * Math.cos(angle);
86	      const wy = attractor.pos[1] + rk * Math.sin(angle);
87	      points.push([wx, wy]);
88	    }
89	  } else {
90	    // Hyperbolic trajectory
91	    if (e <= 1) return [];
92	    const a = mu / (2 * Math.abs(eps));
93	    const p = a * (e * e - 1);
94	    const thetaMax = Math.acos(-1 / e) - 0.02;
95	    const count = 120;
96	    for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
97	      const theta = -thetaMax + (k / (count - 1)) * 2 * thetaMax;
98	      const denom = 1 + e * Math.cos(theta);
99	      if (denom < 1e-10) continue;
100	      const rk = p / denom;
101	      const angle = theta + eAngle;
102	      const wx = attractor.pos[0] + rk * Math.cos(angle);
103	      const wy = attractor.pos[1] + rk * Math.sin(angle);
104	      points.push([wx, wy]);
105	    }
106	  }
107	
108	  return points;
109	}
110	
111	function numericalPath(idx: number, bodies: BodyData[]): Point2D[] {
112	  const n = bodies.length;
113	  const posX = new Float64Array(n);
114	  const posY = new Float64Array(n);
115	  const velX = new Float64Array(n);
116	  const velY = new Float64Array(n);
117	
118	  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
119	    posX[i] = bodies[i].pos[0];
120	    posY[i] = bodies[i].pos[1];
121	    velX[i] = bodies[i].vel[0];
122	    velY[i] = bodies[i].vel[1];
123	  }
124	
125	  const dt = DT * 4;
126	  const totalSteps = 300;
127	  const recordEvery = 5;
128	  const points: Point2D[] = [];
129	
130	  for (let step = 0; step < totalSteps; step++) {
131	    // Euler integration for all bodies
132	    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
133	      let ax = 0;
134	      let ay = 0;
135	      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
136	        if (j === i) continue;
137	        const dx = posX[j] - posX[i];
138	        const dy = posY[j] - posY[i];
139	        const r2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + SOFTENING_EPSILON * SOFTENING_EPSILON;
140	        const aMag = G * bodies[j].mass / r2;
141	        const r = Math.sqrt(r2);
142	        ax += (aMag * dx) / r;
143	        ay += (aMag * dy) / r;
144	      }
145	      velX[i] += ax * dt;
146	      velY[i] += ay * dt;
147	    }
148	    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
149	      posX[i] += velX[i] * dt;
150	      posY[i] += velY[i] * dt;
151	    }
152	
153	    if (step % recordEvery === 0) {
154	      points.push([posX[idx], posY[idx]]);
155	    }
156	  }
157	
158	  return points;
159	}

307	        buf[head * 2 + 1] = bodies[i].pos[1];
308	        this.trailHead[i] = (head + 1) % TRAIL_BUFFER_LENGTH;
309	        if (this.trailLen[i] < TRAIL_BUFFER_LENGTH) this.trailLen[i]++;
310	      }
311	    }
312	
313	    // ── Update uniforms ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
314	    this._uniF[0] = camera.center[0];
315	    this._uniF[1] = camera.center[1];
316	    this._uniF[2] = camera.scale;
317	    this._uniU[3] = n;
318	    this._uniF[4] = W;
319	    this._uniF[5] = H;
320	    this._uniF[6] = 0;
321	    this._uniF[7] = 0;
322	    this.device.queue.writeBuffer(this.uniformBuffer, 0, this._uniBuffer);
323	
324	    // ── Bind group — cache per buffer reference (physics ping-pongs 2 bufs) ─
325	    let bindGroup = this._bindGroupCache.get(bodyBuffer);
326	    if (!bindGroup) {
327	      bindGroup = this.device.createBindGroup({
328	        layout: this.pipeline.getBindGroupLayout(0),
329	        entries: [
330	          { binding: 0, resource: { buffer: bodyBuffer } },
331	          { binding: 1, resource: { buffer: this.uniformBuffer } },
332	        ],
333	      });
334	      this._bindGroupCache.set(bodyBuffer, bindGroup);
335	    }
336	
337	    // ── WebGPU render pass ────────────────────────────────────────────────
338	    const encoder = this.device.createCommandEncoder();
339	    const pass = encoder.beginRenderPass({
340	      colorAttachments: [{
341	        view: this.ctx.getCurrentTexture().createView(),
342	        loadOp: 'clear',
343	        clearValue: { r: 0.02, g: 0.039, b: 0.078, a: 1 },
344	        storeOp: 'store',
345	      }],
346	    });
347	    pass.setPipeline(this.pipeline);
348	    pass.setBindGroup(0, bindGroup);
349	    if (n > 0) pass.draw(6, n);
350	    pass.end();
351	    this.device.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
352	
353	    // ── Canvas 2D overlay ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
354	    const c = this.ctx2d;
355	    c.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
356	
357	    this.drawStarfield(W, H);
358	
359	    if (featureFlags.orbitPaths) {
360	      this.drawOrbitPaths(orbitPaths, camera, W, H, bodies, n);
361	    }
362	
363	    if (featureFlags.trails) {
364	      this.drawTrails(bodies, n, camera, W, H);
365	    }
366	
367	    if (featureFlags.velocityArrows) {
368	      this.drawVelocityArrows(bodies, n, camera, W, H, dragState, selectedBodyIndex);
369	    }
370	
371	    this.drawTemperatureHalos(bodies, bodyStates, n, camera, W, H);
372	    this.drawCollisionPulses(bodies, n, camera, W, H, now);
373	    this.drawHoverRing(bodies, n, camera, W, H, hoveredIndex);
374	    this.drawDragVector(dragState, camera, W, H);
375	    this.drawGhostBody(ghostBody, camera, W, H);
376	
377	    if (featureFlags.gasExchange) {
378	      this.drawGasExchange(bodies, n, camera, W, H);
379	    }
380	
381	    if (featureFlags.labels) {
382	      this.drawLabels(bodies, bodyStates, n, camera, W, H, selectedBodyIndex);
383	    }
384	
385	    if (featureFlags.lagrangePoints && lagrangePoints !== null) {
386	      this.drawLagrangePoints(lagrangePoints, featureFlags.lagrangeCount, camera, W, H);
387	    }
388	
389	    this.drawBlackHoles(bodies, bodyStates, n, camera, W, H);
390	
391	    // ── HUD ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
392	    this.hudEl.innerHTML =
393	      `<span class="label">BODIES</span> ${n}` +
394	      `<br><span class="label">SPEED</span>  ${timeScale.toFixed(1)}×` +
395	      (paused ? '<br><span class="ksp-status">● PAUSED</span>' : '');
396	  }
397	
398	  destroy(): void {
399	    this.uniformBuffer.destroy();
400	  }
401	
402	  // ── Private drawing helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────
403	
404	  private drawStarfield(W: number, H: number): void {
405	    const c = this.ctx2d;
406	    for (const s of this.stars) {
407	      c.beginPath();
408	      c.arc(s.x * W, s.y * H, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
409	      c.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${s.a})`;
410	      c.fill();
411	    }
412	  }
413	
414	  private drawTrails(
415	    bodies: BodyData[],
416	    n: number,
417	    camera: Camera,
418	    W: number,
419	    H: number,
420	  ): void {
421	    const c = this.ctx2d;
422	    for (let i = 0; i < n && i < this.trails.length; i++) {
423	      const len = this.trailLen[i];
424	      if (len < 2) continue;
425	
426	      const buf   = this.trails[i];
427	      const head  = this.trailHead[i];
428	      const color = trailColor(bodies[i].mass);
429	
430	      c.beginPath();
431	      let first = true;
432	      for (let j = 0; j < len; j++) {
433	        // oldest point first: (head - len + j + TRAIL_BUFFER_LENGTH) % TRAIL_BUFFER_LENGTH
434	        const idx = (head - len + j + TRAIL_BUFFER_LENGTH) % TRAIL_BUFFER_LENGTH;
435	        const wx = buf[idx * 2];
436	        const wy = buf[idx * 2 + 1];
437	        const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen([wx, wy], camera, W, H);
438	        const alpha = (j / (len - 1)) * 0.7;
439	        if (first) {
440	          c.moveTo(sx, sy);
441	          first = false;
442	        } else {
443	          // Draw segment by segment so we can vary alpha
444	          c.strokeStyle = `rgba(${color},${alpha.toFixed(3)})`;
445	          c.lineWidth = 1.5;
446	          c.lineTo(sx, sy);
447	          c.stroke();
448	          c.beginPath();
449	          c.moveTo(sx, sy);
450	        }
451	      }
452	    }
453	  }
454	
455	  private drawCollisionPulses(
456	    bodies: BodyData[],
457	    n: number,
458	    camera: Camera,
459	    W: number,
460	    H: number,
461	    now: number,
462	  ): void {
463	    const c = this.ctx2d;
464	    this.pulses = this.pulses.filter(pulse => {
465	      const progress = (now - pulse.startTime) / 500;
466	      if (progress >= 1) return false;
467	      const bi = pulse.idx;
468	      if (bi >= n || bi >= bodies.length) return false;
469	
470	      const body = bodies[bi];
471	      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(body.pos, camera, W, H);
472	      const r = bodyRadius(body.mass) * camera.scale * (1 + progress * 3);
473	      const alpha = 1 - progress;
474	
475	      c.beginPath();
476	      c.arc(sx, sy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
477	      c.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha.toFixed(3)})`;
478	      c.lineWidth = 1.5;
479	      c.stroke();
480	      return true;
481	    });
482	  }
483	
484	  private drawHoverRing(
485	    bodies: BodyData[],
486	    n: number,
487	    camera: Camera,
488	    W: number,
489	    H: number,
490	    hoveredIndex: number,
491	  ): void {
492	    if (hoveredIndex < 0 || hoveredIndex >= n) return;
493	    const body = bodies[hoveredIndex];
494	    const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(body.pos, camera, W, H);
495	    const r = bodyRadius(body.mass) * camera.scale * 1.4;
496	    const c = this.ctx2d;
497	    c.beginPath();
498	    c.arc(sx, sy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
499	    c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
500	    c.lineWidth = 1;
501	    c.stroke();
502	  }
503	
504	  private drawDragVector(
505	    dragState: DragState,
506	    camera: Camera,
507	    W: number,
508	    H: number,
509	  ): void {
510	    if (!dragState.active) return;
511	    const hist = dragState.mouseHistory;
512	    if (hist.length < 2) return;
513	
514	    // Velocity vector from history: diff between oldest and newest
515	    const oldest = hist[0];
516	    const newest  = hist[hist.length - 1];
517	    let vx = (newest[0] - oldest[0]) * 20;
518	    let vy = (newest[1] - oldest[1]) * 20;
519	
520	    // Clamp to 200px
521	    const vLen = Math.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy);
522	    if (vLen > 200) { vx = (vx / vLen) * 200; vy = (vy / vLen) * 200; }
523	    if (vLen < 1) return;
524	
525	    const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(dragState.bodyWorldPos, camera, W, H);
526	    const ex = sx + vx;
527	    const ey = sy + vy;
528	
529	    const c = this.ctx2d;
530	    c.save();
531	    c.setLineDash([5, 4]);
532	    c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
533	    c.lineWidth = 1.5;
534	    c.beginPath();
535	    c.moveTo(sx, sy);
536	    c.lineTo(ex, ey);
537	    c.stroke();
538	
539	    // Arrowhead
540	    c.setLineDash([]);
541	    const angle = Math.atan2(ey - sy, ex - sx);
542	    const headLen = 8;
543	    c.beginPath();
544	    c.moveTo(ex, ey);
545	    c.lineTo(
546	      ex - headLen * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 6),
547	      ey - headLen * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 6),
548	    );
549	    c.moveTo(ex, ey);
550	    c.lineTo(
551	      ex - headLen * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 6),
552	      ey - headLen * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 6),
553	    );
554	    c.stroke();
555	    c.restore();
556	  }
557	
558	  private drawGhostBody(
559	    ghostBody: BodyData | null,
560	    camera: Camera,
561	    W: number,
562	    H: number,
563	  ): void {
564	    if (!ghostBody) return;
565	    const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(ghostBody.pos, camera, W, H);
566	    const r   = bodyRadius(ghostBody.mass) * camera.scale;
567	    const glowR = r * 5;
568	    const c = this.ctx2d;
569	
570	    c.save();
571	    c.globalAlpha = 0.4;
572	
573	    // Glow gradient approximation
574	    const grad = c.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, glowR);
575	    const color = trailColor(ghostBody.mass);
576	    grad.addColorStop(0,   `rgba(${color},1)`);
577	    grad.addColorStop(0.18,`rgba(${color},1)`);
578	    grad.addColorStop(1,   `rgba(${color},0)`);
579	    c.beginPath();
580	    c.arc(sx, sy, glowR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
581	    c.fillStyle = grad;
582	    c.fill();
583	
584	    // Dashed outline at actual radius
585	    c.setLineDash([4, 4]);
586	    c.strokeStyle = `rgba(${color},0.8)`;
587	    c.lineWidth = 1;
588	    c.beginPath();
589	    c.arc(sx, sy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
590	    c.stroke();
591	
592	    c.restore();
593	  }
594	
595	  private drawVelocityArrows(
596	    bodies: BodyData[],
597	    n: number,
598	    camera: Camera,
599	    W: number,
600	    H: number,
601	    dragState: DragState,
602	    selectedBodyIndex: number,
603	  ): void {
604	    const c = this.ctx2d;
605	    const VEL_SCALE = 1;
606	    const VEL_MAX_PX = 80;
607	    const VEL_MIN_PX = 8;
608	    const HEAD_LEN = 7;
609	
610	    for (let i = 0; i < n && i < bodies.length; i++) {
611	      if (dragState.active && dragState.bodyIndex === i) continue;
612	      if (selectedBodyIndex === i) continue;
613	      const body = bodies[i];
614	      const [vx, vy] = body.vel;
615	      const speed = Math.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy);
616	      if (speed < 0.1) continue;
617	
618	      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(body.pos, camera, W, H);
619	      const rawLen = speed * camera.scale * VEL_SCALE;
620	      const pxLen = Math.max(VEL_MIN_PX, Math.min(rawLen, VEL_MAX_PX));
621	      const nx = vx / speed;
622	      const ny = vy / speed;
623	      const ex = sx + nx * pxLen;
624	      const ey = sy + ny * pxLen;
625	
626	      const color = trailColor(body.mass);
627	      const angle = Math.atan2(ey - sy, ex - sx);
628	
629	      c.save();
630	      c.strokeStyle = `rgba(${color},0.55)`;
631	      c.lineWidth = 1.5;
632	
633	      c.beginPath();
634	      c.moveTo(sx, sy);
635	      c.lineTo(ex, ey);
636	      c.stroke();
637	
638	      c.beginPath();
639	      c.moveTo(ex, ey);
640	      c.lineTo(ex - HEAD_LEN * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 6), ey - HEAD_LEN * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 6));
641	      c.moveTo(ex, ey);
642	      c.lineTo(ex - HEAD_LEN * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 6), ey - HEAD_LEN * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 6));
643	      c.stroke();
644	
645	      c.restore();
646	    }
647	  }
648	
649	  private drawOrbitPaths(
650	    paths: [number, number][][],
651	    camera: Camera,
652	    W: number,
653	    H: number,
654	    bodies: BodyData[],
655	    n: number,
656	  ): void {
657	    const c = this.ctx2d;
658	    for (let i = 0; i < paths.length && i < n; i++) {
659	      const path = paths[i];
660	      if (path.length < 2) continue;
661	      const color = trailColor(bodies[i]?.mass ?? 1);
662	
663	      c.save();
664	      c.setLineDash([4, 6]);
665	      c.strokeStyle = `rgba(${color},0.28)`;
666	      c.lineWidth = 1;
667	      c.beginPath();
668	      for (let j = 0; j < path.length; j++) {
669	        const [wx, wy] = path[j];
670	        const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen([wx, wy], camera, W, H);
671	        if (j === 0) c.moveTo(sx, sy);
672	        else c.lineTo(sx, sy);
673	      }
674	      c.stroke();
675	      c.restore();
676	
677	      // ── Apsis markers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
678	      if (path.length < 4) continue;
679	
680	      // Find dominant attractor by locating body closest to orbit mean centre
681	      let sumX = 0, sumY = 0;
682	      for (const pt of path) { sumX += pt[0]; sumY += pt[1]; }
683	      const mX = sumX / path.length, mY = sumY / path.length;
684	      let attIdx = -1, minAttD = Infinity;
685	      for (let j = 0; j < n && j < bodies.length; j++) {
686	        if (j === i) continue;
687	        const dx = bodies[j].pos[0] - mX, dy = bodies[j].pos[1] - mY;
688	        const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
689	        if (d < minAttD) { minAttD = d; attIdx = j; }
690	      }
691	      if (attIdx < 0) continue;
692	      const ap = bodies[attIdx].pos;
693	
694	      let minD = Infinity, maxD = -Infinity;
695	      let periPt = path[0], apoPt = path[0];
696	      for (const pt of path) {
697	        const dx = pt[0] - ap[0], dy = pt[1] - ap[1];
698	        const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
699	        if (d < minD) { minD = d; periPt = pt; }
700	        if (d > maxD) { maxD = d; apoPt = pt; }
701	      }
702	
703	      // Only show when orbit is meaningfully eccentric (>2% variation)
704	      if (maxD / Math.max(minD, 1) < 1.02) continue;
705	
706	      c.save();
707	      c.font = `bold 12px 'Geist Mono', monospace`;
708	      c.textBaseline = 'middle';
709	      c.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.9)';
710	      c.shadowBlur = 4;
711	
712	      // Periapsis — orange
713	      const [psx, psy] = worldToScreen(periPt, camera, W, H);
714	      c.beginPath();
715	      c.arc(psx, psy, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
716	      c.fillStyle = '#FF8C00';
717	      c.fill();
718	      c.fillStyle = '#FF8C00';
719	      c.textAlign = 'left';
720	      c.fillText('Pe', psx + 6, psy);
721	
722	      // Apoapsis — cyan
723	      const [asx, asy] = worldToScreen(apoPt, camera, W, H);
724	      c.beginPath();
725	      c.arc(asx, asy, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
726	      c.fillStyle = '#40A0FF';
727	      c.fill();
728	      c.fillStyle = '#40A0FF';
729	      c.fillText('Ap', asx + 6, asy);
730	
731	      c.restore();
732	    }
733	  }
734	
735	  private drawLabels(
736	    bodies: BodyData[],
737	    states: BodyState[],
738	    n: number,
739	    camera: Camera,
740	    W: number,
741	    H: number,
742	    selectedIdx: number,
743	  ): void {
744	    const c = this.ctx2d;
745	    c.font = `bold 15px 'Geist Mono', monospace`;
746	    c.textAlign = 'center';
747	    c.textBaseline = 'bottom';
748	
749	    for (let i = 0; i < n && i < bodies.length; i++) {
750	      const body = bodies[i];
751	      const state = states[i];
752	      if (!state) continue;
753	      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(body.pos, camera, W, H);
754	      const r = Math.max(6, bodyRadius(body.mass) * camera.scale);
755	      const labelY = sy - r - 5;
756	
757	      const isSelected = i === selectedIdx;
758	      c.save();
759	      c.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
760	      c.shadowBlur = 4;
761	      c.fillStyle = isSelected ? 'rgba(255,165,0,0.95)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.80)';
762	      c.fillText(state.name, sx, labelY);
763	      c.restore();
764	    }
765	  }
766	
767	  private drawLagrangePoints(
768	    points: [number, number][],
769	    count: 0 | 2 | 5,
770	    camera: Camera,
771	    W: number,
772	    H: number,
773	  ): void {
774	    if (count === 0) return;
775	    const c = this.ctx2d;
776	    const labels = ['L1', 'L2', 'L3', 'L4', 'L5'];
777	    const startIdx = count === 2 ? 3 : 0;
778	
779	    c.save();
780	    c.font = `bold 13px 'Geist Mono', monospace`;
781	    c.textAlign = 'center';
782	    c.textBaseline = 'middle';
783	    c.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
784	    c.shadowBlur = 3;
785	
786	    for (let i = startIdx; i < points.length && i < 5; i++) {
787	      const pt = points[i];
788	      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(pt, camera, W, H);
789	      const s = 8;
790	      c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80,230,130,0.75)';
791	      c.lineWidth = 2;
792	      c.beginPath();
793	      c.moveTo(sx - s, sy - s);
794	      c.lineTo(sx + s, sy + s);
795	      c.moveTo(sx + s, sy - s);
796	      c.lineTo(sx - s, sy + s);
797	      c.stroke();
798	
799	      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,240,150,0.90)';
800	      c.fillText(labels[i], sx, sy - 14);
801	    }
802	    c.restore();
803	  }
804	
805	  private _gasRng_next(): number {
806	    this._gasRng = lcg(this._gasRng);
807	    return (this._gasRng >>> 0) / 0x100000000;
808	  }
809	
810	  private drawGasExchange(
811	    bodies: BodyData[],
812	    n: number,
813	    camera: Camera,
814	    W: number,
815	    H: number,
816	  ): void {
817	    const c = this.ctx2d;
818	    const MAX_PARTICLES = 200;
819	    const CLOSE_DIST = 120; // world units
820	
821	    // Update existing particles
822	    for (const p of this._gasParticles) {
823	      p.x += p.vx;
824	      p.y += p.vy;
825	      p.life += 0.02;
826	    }
827	
828	    // Remove dead particles
829	    this._gasParticles = this._gasParticles.filter(p => p.life < 1);
830	
831	    // Spawn new particles for close pairs
832	    if (this._gasParticles.length < MAX_PARTICLES) {
833	      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
834	        for (let j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
835	          const bi = bodies[i];
836	          const bj = bodies[j];
837	          const dx = bj.pos[0] - bi.pos[0];
838	          const dy = bj.pos[1] - bi.pos[1];
839	          const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
840	          if (dist < CLOSE_DIST && this._gasParticles.length < MAX_PARTICLES) {
841	            // Spawn up to 2 particles per pair per frame
842	            for (let k = 0; k < 2 && this._gasParticles.length < MAX_PARTICLES; k++) {
843	              // Spawn at source body
844	              const fromI = this._gasRng_next() < 0.5;
845	              const src = fromI ? bi : bj;
846	              const tgt = fromI ? bj : bi;
847	              const txd = tgt.pos[0] - src.pos[0];
848	              const tyd = tgt.pos[1] - src.pos[1];
849	              const tlen = Math.sqrt(txd * txd + tyd * tyd) || 1;
850	              const speed = 0.4 + this._gasRng_next() * 0.6;
851	              const randAngle = (this._gasRng_next() - 0.5) * 0.8;
852	              const cos = Math.cos(randAngle);
853	              const sin = Math.sin(randAngle);
854	              const bvx = txd / tlen;
855	              const bvy = tyd / tlen;
856	              const vx = (bvx * cos - bvy * sin) * speed;
857	              const vy = (bvx * sin + bvy * cos) * speed;
858	              const color = trailColor(src.mass);
859	              this._gasParticles.push({
860	                x: src.pos[0] + (this._gasRng_next() - 0.5) * src.radius * 2,
861	                y: src.pos[1] + (this._gasRng_next() - 0.5) * src.radius * 2,
862	                vx,
863	                vy,
864	                life: 0,
865	                color,
866	              });
867	            }
868	          }
869	        }
870	      }
871	    }
872	
873	    // Draw particles
874	    for (const p of this._gasParticles) {
875	      const alpha = (1 - p.life) * 0.7;
876	      if (alpha <= 0) continue;
877	      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen([p.x, p.y], camera, W, H);
878	      c.beginPath();
879	      c.arc(sx, sy, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
880	      c.fillStyle = `rgba(${p.color},${alpha.toFixed(3)})`;
881	      c.fill();
882	    }

885	  private drawTemperatureHalos(

887	    states: BodyState[],
888	    n: number,
889	    camera: Camera,
890	    W: number,
891	    H: number,
892	  ): void {

898	      if (isBlackHole(body.mass, body.radius)) continue;

902	      const rgb = temperatureToColor(state.temperature);

907	      grad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(${rgb},0.10)`);
908	      grad.addColorStop(1,   `rgba(${rgb},0)`);
909	      c.beginPath();
910	      c.arc(sx, sy, r * 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
911	      c.fillStyle = grad;
912	      c.fill();
913	    }
914	  }

930	
931	      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(body.pos, camera, W, H);
932	      const innerR = body.radius * camera.scale * 1.2;
933	      const outerR = innerR * 2.0;
934	
935	      // Accretion ring gradient
936	      const grad = c.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, innerR * 1.3, sx, sy, outerR);
937	      grad.addColorStop(0,   'rgba(255,160,40,0.85)');
938	      grad.addColorStop(0.3, 'rgba(255,80,20,0.50)');
939	      grad.addColorStop(1,   'rgba(255,40,0,0.00)');
940	
941	      c.beginPath();
942	      c.arc(sx, sy, outerR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
943	      c.fillStyle = grad;
944	      c.fill();
945	
946	      // Black disk (covers WebGPU glow underneath)
947	      c.beginPath();
948	      c.arc(sx, sy, innerR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
949	      c.fillStyle = '#000000';
950	      c.fill();
951	    }
952	  }

12	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
13	// WGSL compute shader — staggered leapfrog (drift-kick style)
14	// Velocities are stored at half-integer steps; positions at integer steps.
15	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
16	const COMPUTE_SHADER = /* wgsl */ `
17	struct Body {
18	  pos    : vec2f,
19	  vel    : vec2f,
20	  mass   : f32,
21	  radius : f32,
22	  _pad   : vec2f,
23	}
24	
25	struct Params {
26	  n   : u32,
27	  dt  : f32,
28	  G   : f32,
29	  _pad : f32,
30	}
31	
32	@group(0) @binding(0) var<storage, read>       bodyIn  : array<Body>;
33	@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read_write> bodyOut : array<Body>;
34	@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform>             params  : Params;
35	
36	@compute @workgroup_size(1)
37	fn main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid : vec3u) {
38	  let i = gid.x;
39	  if (i >= params.n) { return; }
40	
41	  var b = bodyIn[i];
42	  var acc = vec2f(0.0);
43	
44	  for (var j : u32 = 0u; j < params.n; j++) {
45	    if (j == i) { continue; }
46	    let r  = bodyIn[j].pos - b.pos;
47	    let r2 = dot(r, r) + ${SOFTENING_EPSILON * SOFTENING_EPSILON};
48	    let dist_sq = dot(r, r);
49	    let dist = sqrt(dist_sq);
50	    let aMag = params.G * bodyIn[j].mass / r2;
51	    let closeThresh = (b.radius + bodyIn[j].radius) * 3.0;
52	    let tidalFactor = select(1.0, 1.0 + 0.3 * (1.0 - dist / max(closeThresh, 0.001)), dist < closeThresh);
53	    acc += r * ((aMag / sqrt(r2)) * tidalFactor);
54	  }
55	
56	  b.vel += acc * params.dt;
57	  b.pos += b.vel * params.dt;
58	  bodyOut[i] = b;
59	}
60	`;

66	/** Write a single BodyData into a DataView at the given byte offset. */
67	function writeBody(view: DataView, byteOffset: number, b: BodyData): void {
68	  view.setFloat32(byteOffset + 0,  b.pos[0],  true);
69	  view.setFloat32(byteOffset + 4,  b.pos[1],  true);

75	  view.setFloat32(byteOffset + 28, 0,         true); // _pad1
76	}
77	
78	/** Read a single BodyData from a DataView at the given byte offset. */

80	  return {
81	    pos:    [view.getFloat32(byteOffset + 0,  true), view.getFloat32(byteOffset + 4,  true)],
82	    vel:    [view.getFloat32(byteOffset + 8,  true), view.getFloat32(byteOffset + 12, true)],

88	/**

90	 * Uses the same softening as the GPU shader.
91	 */
92	function cpuAcceleration(bodies: BodyData[], i: number): [number, number] {
93	  let ax = 0;
94	  let ay = 0;
95	  const bi = bodies[i];
96	  for (let j = 0; j < bodies.length; j++) {
97	    if (j === i) continue;
98	    const bj = bodies[j];
99	    const dx = bj.pos[0] - bi.pos[0];
100	    const dy = bj.pos[1] - bi.pos[1];
101	    const r2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + SOFTENING_EPSILON * SOFTENING_EPSILON;
102	    const aMag = (G * bj.mass) / r2;
103	    const r = Math.sqrt(r2);
104	    ax += (aMag * dx) / r;
105	    ay += (aMag * dy) / r;
106	  }
107	  return [ax, ay];
108	}

168	  init(bodies: BodyData[]): void {

204

304	  private _buildPipeline(): void {
305	    const device = this.device;
306	    const bufferSize = MAX_BODIES * BODY_STRIDE;
307	
308	    // Body buffers (ping-pong)
309	    const bufUsage = GPUBufferUsage.STORAGE | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_SRC | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST;
310	    this.bufA = device.createBuffer({ size: bufferSize, usage: bufUsage });
311	    this.bufB = device.createBuffer({ size: bufferSize, usage: bufUsage });
312	
313	    // Params uniform buffer
314	    this.paramsBuffer = device.createBuffer({
315	      size:  16,
316	      usage: GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST,
317	    });
318	
319	    // Staging buffer for CPU readback
320	    this.stagingBuffer = device.createBuffer({
321	      size:  bufferSize,
322	      usage: GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST | GPUBufferUsage.MAP_READ,
323	    });
324	
325	    // Shader module
326	    const shaderModule = device.createShaderModule({ code: COMPUTE_SHADER });
327	
328	    // Bind group layout
329	    this.bindGroupLayout = device.createBindGroupLayout({
330	      entries: [
331	        { binding: 0, visibility: GPUShaderStage.COMPUTE, buffer: { type: "read-only-storage" } },
332	        { binding: 1, visibility: GPUShaderStage.COMPUTE, buffer: { type: "storage"           } },
333	        { binding: 2, visibility: GPUShaderStage.COMPUTE, buffer: { type: "uniform"            } },
334	      ],
335	    });
336	
337	    // Pipeline
338	    this.pipeline = device.createComputePipeline({
339	      layout: device.createPipelineLayout({ bindGroupLayouts: [this.bindGroupLayout] }),
340	      compute: { module: shaderModule, entryPoint: "main" },
341	    });
342	
343	    // Bind groups
344	    this.bgAtoB = this._makeBindGroup(this.bufA, this.bufB);
345	    this.bgBtoA = this._makeBindGroup(this.bufB, this.bufA);
346	  }
347	
348	  private _makeBindGroup(src: GPUBuffer, dst: GPUBuffer): GPUBindGroup {
349	    return this.device.createBindGroup({
350	      layout: this.bindGroupLayout,
351	      entries: [
352	        { binding: 0, resource: { buffer: src               } },
353	        { binding: 1, resource: { buffer: dst               } },
354	        { binding: 2, resource: { buffer: this.paramsBuffer } },
355	      ],
356	    });
357	  }
358	
359	  private _uploadBothBuffers(bodies: BodyData[]): void {
360	    const arrayBuf = new ArrayBuffer(MAX_BODIES * BODY_STRIDE);
361	    const view     = new DataView(arrayBuf);
362	    for (let i = 0; i < bodies.length; i++) {
363	      writeBody(view, i * BODY_STRIDE, bodies[i]);
364	    }
365	    this.device.queue.writeBuffer(this.bufA, 0, arrayBuf);
366	    this.device.queue.writeBuffer(this.bufB, 0, arrayBuf);
367	  }
368	
369	  private _checkCollisions(bodies: BodyData[]): void {
370	    for (let i = 0; i < bodies.length; i++) {
371	      for (let j = i + 1; j < bodies.length; j++) {
372	        const bi = bodies[i];
373	        const bj = bodies[j];
374	        const dx   = bj.pos[0] - bi.pos[0];
375	        const dy   = bj.pos[1] - bi.pos[1];
376	        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
377	        if (dist < (bi.radius + bj.radius) * COLLISION_OVERLAP) {
378	          this.onMerge(i, j);
379	          // One merge per readback frame — indices invalidated after merge, stop.
380	          return;
381	        }
382	      }
383	    }
384	  }

  "new_string": "import type { BodyData } from './constants';\nimport { G, DT, SOFTENING_EPSILON } from './constants';\n\n/**\n * For each body, returns the index of its dominant gravitational attractor.\n * Returns -1 for the most massive body (it has no dominant attractor).\n */\nexport function findAttractors(bodies: BodyData[]): number[] {\n  return bodies.map((body, idx) => {\n    let maxForce = 0;\n    let attractorIdx = -1;\n    for (let j = 0; j < bodies.length; j++) {\n      if (j === idx) continue;\n      const dx = bodies[j].pos[0] - body.pos[0];\n      const dy = bodies[j].pos[1] - body.pos[1];\n      const r2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + SOFTENING_EPSILON * SOFTENING_EPSILON;\n      const force = G * bodies[j].mass / r2;\n      if (force > maxForce) {\n        maxForce = force;\n        attractorIdx = j;\n      }\n    }\n    return attractorIdx;\n  });\n}"
}
```

```typescript
export function findAttractors(bodies: BodyData[]): number[] {
  return bodies.map((body, idx) => {
    let maxForce = 0;
    let attractorIdx = -1;
    for (let j = 0; j < bodies.length; j++) {
      if (j === idx) continue;
      const dx = bodies[j].pos[0] - body.pos[0];
      const dy = bodies[j].pos[1] - body.pos[1];
      const r2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + SOFTENING_EPSILON * SOFTENING_EPSILON;
      const force = G * bodies[j].mass / r2;
      if (force > maxForce) { maxForce = force; attractorIdx = j; }
    }
    return attractorIdx;
  });
}
```

5. Problem Solving:

**Key insight — visual/physics decoupling**: The fundamental issue was that `body.radius` served dual purpose: (1) collision detection physics (needs to reflect planet size), (2) WebGPU visual glow (`glowR = body.radius * scale * 5.0`). With large planet masses needed for Hill sphere physics, the visual glow became enormous. Solution: make `body.radius` tiny (log formula, max=5), compute visual size from `body.mass` using log scale in WGSL shader and 2D canvas.

**Visual size formula** (to be applied in WGSL and 2D canvas):
```
visR_world = max(8, (log10(mass) - 1) * 7 + 2)
```
At scale=0.5:
- Sun (1e6): 37 world → 18.5px screen
- Jupiter (80000): 29.3 → 14.7px
- Earth (30000): 26.4 → 13.2px
- Moon (30): 8 (min) → 4px screen
- Moon at orbit 40: screen dist=20px > Earth disc 13.2px → clearly outside ✓

597	  private drawVelocityArrows(
598	    bodies: BodyData[],
599	    n: number,

602	    H: number,
603	    dragState: DragState,

609	    const VEL_MIN_PX = 8;

612	    for (let i = 0; i < n && i < bodies.length; i++) {

614	      if (selectedBodyIndex === i) continue;

617	      const speed = Math.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy);
618	      if (speed < 0.1) continue;
619	
620	      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(body.pos, camera, W, H);
621	      const rawLen = speed * camera.scale * VEL_SCALE;
622	      const pxLen = Math.max(VEL_MIN_PX, Math.min(rawLen, VEL_MAX_PX));
623	      const nx = vx / speed;
624	      const ny = vy / speed;
625	      const ex = sx + nx * pxLen;
626	      const ey = sy + ny * pxLen;
627	
628	      const color = trailColor(body.mass);
629	      const angle = Math.atan2(ey - sy, ex - sx);
630	
631	      c.save();
632	      c.strokeStyle = `rgba(${color},0.55)`;
633	      c.lineWidth = 1.5;
634	
635	      c.beginPath();
636	      c.moveTo(sx, sy);
637	      c.lineTo(ex, ey);
638	      c.stroke();
639	
640	      c.beginPath();
641	      c.moveTo(ex, ey);
642	      c.lineTo(ex - HEAD_LEN * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 6), ey - HEAD_LEN * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 6));
643	      c.moveTo(ex, ey);
644	      c.lineTo(ex - HEAD_LEN * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 6), ey - HEAD_LEN * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 6));
645	      c.stroke();
646	
647	      c.restore();
648	    }

651	  private drawOrbitPaths(
652	    paths: [number, number][][],
653	    camera: Camera,
654	    W: number,
655	    H: number,
656	    bodies: BodyData[],
657	    n: number,
658	    selectedIdx: number,
659	  ): void {
660	    const c = this.ctx2d;
661	    for (let i = 0; i < paths.length && i < n; i++) {
662	      const path = paths[i];
663	      if (path.length < 2) continue;
664	      const color = trailColor(bodies[i]?.mass ?? 1);
665	      const isSelected = i === selectedIdx;
666	
667	      c.save();
668	      c.setLineDash([4, 6]);
669	      // Selected orbit is brighter
670	      c.strokeStyle = isSelected
671	        ? `rgba(${color},0.55)`
672	        : `rgba(${color},0.22)`;
673	      c.lineWidth = isSelected ? 1.5 : 1;
674	      c.beginPath();
675	      for (let j = 0; j < path.length; j++) {
676	        const [wx, wy] = path[j];
677	        const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen([wx, wy], camera, W, H);
678	        if (j === 0) c.moveTo(sx, sy);
679	        else c.lineTo(sx, sy);
680	      }
681	      c.stroke();
682	      c.restore();
683	
684	      // ── Apsis markers — only for selected body ─────────────────────────────
685	      if (!isSelected || path.length < 4) continue;
686	
687	      // Find dominant attractor by locating body closest to orbit mean centre
688	      let sumX = 0, sumY = 0;
689	      for (const pt of path) { sumX += pt[0]; sumY += pt[1]; }
690	      const mX = sumX / path.length, mY = sumY / path.length;
691	      let attIdx = -1, minAttD = Infinity;
692	      for (let j = 0; j < n && j < bodies.length; j++) {
693	        if (j === i) continue;
694	        const dx = bodies[j].pos[0] - mX, dy = bodies[j].pos[1] - mY;
695	        const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
696	        if (d < minAttD) { minAttD = d; attIdx = j; }
697	      }
698	      if (attIdx < 0) continue;
699	      const ap = bodies[attIdx].pos;
700	
701	      let minD = Infinity, maxD = -Infinity;
702	      let periPt = path[0], apoPt = path[0];
703	      for (const pt of path) {
704	        const dx = pt[0] - ap[0], dy = pt[1] - ap[1];
705	        const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
706	        if (d < minD) { minD = d; periPt = pt; }
707	        if (d > maxD) { maxD = d; apoPt = pt; }
708	      }
709	
710	      // Only show when orbit is meaningfully eccentric (>2% variation)
711	      if (maxD / Math.max(minD, 1) < 1.02) continue;
712	
713	      c.save();
714	      c.font = `bold 12px 'Geist Mono', monospace`;
715	      c.textBaseline = 'middle';
716	      c.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.9)';
717	      c.shadowBlur = 4;
718	
719	      // Periapsis — orange
720	      const [psx, psy] = worldToScreen(periPt, camera, W, H);
721	      c.beginPath();
722	      c.arc(psx, psy, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
723	      c.fillStyle = '#FF8C00';
724	      c.fill();
725	      c.fillStyle = '#FF8C00';
726	      c.textAlign = 'left';
727	      c.fillText('Pe', psx + 6, psy);
728	
729	      // Apoapsis — cyan
730	      const [asx, asy] = worldToScreen(apoPt, camera, W, H);
731	      c.beginPath();
732	      c.arc(asx, asy, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
733	      c.fillStyle = '#40A0FF';
734	      c.fill();
735	      c.fillStyle = '#40A0FF';
736	      c.fillText('Ap', asx + 6, asy);
737	
738	      c.restore();
739	    }
740	  }

820	  private _gasRng_next(): number {
821	    this._gasRng = lcg(this._gasRng);
822	    return (this._gasRng >>> 0) / 0x100000000;

825	  private drawGasExchange(
826	    bodies: BodyData[],
827	    n: number,
828	    camera: Camera,
829	    W: number,
830	    H: number,
831	  ): void {
832	    const c = this.ctx2d;
833	    const MAX_PARTICLES = 200;
834	    const CLOSE_DIST = 120; // world units
835	
836	    // Update existing particles
837	    for (const p of this._gasParticles) {
838	      p.x += p.vx;
839	      p.y += p.vy;
840	      p.life += 0.02;
841	    }
842	
843	    // Remove dead particles
844	    this._gasParticles = this._gasParticles.filter(p => p.life < 1);
845	
846	    // Spawn new particles for close pairs — planets only (skip moon-mass bodies)
847	    const GAS_MASS_THRESHOLD = 500;
848	    if (this._gasParticles.length < MAX_PARTICLES) {
849	      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
850	        for (let j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
851	          const bi = bodies[i];
852	          const bj = bodies[j];
853	          if (bi.mass < GAS_MASS_THRESHOLD || bj.mass < GAS_MASS_THRESHOLD) continue;
854	          const dx = bj.pos[0] - bi.pos[0];
855	          const dy = bj.pos[1] - bi.pos[1];
856	          const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
857	          if (dist < CLOSE_DIST && this._gasParticles.length < MAX_PARTICLES) {
858	            // Spawn up to 2 particles per pair per frame
859	            for (let k = 0; k < 2 && this._gasParticles.length < MAX_PARTICLES; k++) {
860	              // Spawn at source body
861	              const fromI = this._gasRng_next() < 0.5;
862	              const src = fromI ? bi : bj;
863	              const tgt = fromI ? bj : bi;
864	              const txd = tgt.pos[0] - src.pos[0];
865	              const tyd = tgt.pos[1] - src.pos[1];
866	              const tlen = Math.sqrt(txd * txd + tyd * tyd) || 1;
867	              const speed = 0.4 + this._gasRng_next() * 0.6;
868	              const randAngle = (this._gasRng_next() - 0.5) * 0.8;
869	              const cos = Math.cos(randAngle);
870	              const sin = Math.sin(randAngle);
871	              const bvx = txd / tlen;
872	              const bvy = tyd / tlen;
873	              const vx = (bvx * cos - bvy * sin) * speed;
874	              const vy = (bvx * sin + bvy * cos) * speed;
875	              const color = trailColor(src.mass);
876	              this._gasParticles.push({
877	                x: src.pos[0] + (this._gasRng_next() - 0.5) * src.radius * 2,
878	                y: src.pos[1] + (this._gasRng_next() - 0.5) * src.radius * 2,
879	                vx,
880	                vy,
881	                life: 0,
882	                color,
883	              });
884	            }
885	          }
886	        }
887	      }
888	    }
889	
890	    // Draw particles
891	    for (const p of this._gasParticles) {
892	      const alpha = (1 - p.life) * 0.7;
893	      if (alpha <= 0) continue;
894	      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen([p.x, p.y], camera, W, H);
895	      c.beginPath();
896	      c.arc(sx, sy, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
897	      c.fillStyle = `rgba(${p.color},${alpha.toFixed(3)})`;
898	      c.fill();
899	    }
900	  }

963	      // Black disk (covers WebGPU glow underneath)

36	function bodyAtPerihelion(
37	  a: number,
38	  e: number,

40	  centralMass: number,
41	  centralPos: [number, number],

54	  const vy  = retrograde ? centralVel[1] - v_p * ca : centralVel[1] + v_p * ca;

126	async function init(): Promise<void> {

136	  const adapter = await navigator.gpu.requestAdapter();

143	  const device = await adapter.requestDevice();

162	    overlayCanvas.height = window.innerHeight * dpr;

164	  resizeCanvases();

269	  function recomputeLagrange(): void {
270	    const bodies = physics.cpuBodies;
271	    if (bodies.length < 2) {
272	      lagrangePoints = null;
273	      return;
274	    }
275	
276	    let m1Idx = 0;
277	    let m2Idx = 1;
278	
279	    if (selectedBodyIndex >= 0 && selectedBodyIndex < bodies.length) {
280	      // Use selected body + most massive other
281	      const selIdx = selectedBodyIndex;
282	      let bestOther = -1;
283	      let bestMass = -1;
284	      for (let i = 0; i < bodies.length; i++) {
285	        if (i === selIdx) continue;
286	        if (bodies[i].mass > bestMass) {
287	          bestMass = bodies[i].mass;
288	          bestOther = i;
289	        }
290	      }
291	      if (bestOther >= 0) {
292	        m1Idx = selIdx;
293	        m2Idx = bestOther;
294	        // Ensure m1 is more massive (Lagrange convention)
295	        if (bodies[m2Idx].mass > bodies[m1Idx].mass) {
296	          [m1Idx, m2Idx] = [m2Idx, m1Idx];
297	        }
298	      }
299	    } else {
300	      // Use two most massive bodies
301	      let best = [0, 1];
302	      if (bodies.length > 1 && bodies[1].mass > bodies[0].mass) {
303	        best = [1, 0];
304	      }
305	      for (let i = 2; i < bodies.length; i++) {
306	        if (bodies[i].mass > bodies[best[0]].mass) {
307	          best = [i, best[0]];
308	        } else if (bodies[i].mass > bodies[best[1]].mass) {
309	          best[1] = i;
310	        }
311	      }
312	      m1Idx = best[0];
313	      m2Idx = best[1];
314	    }
315	
316	    const pts = computeLagrangePoints(bodies[m1Idx], bodies[m2Idx]);
317	    lagrangePoints = pts as [number, number][];
318	  }

320	  function recomputeOrbitPaths(): void {
321	    const bodies = physics.cpuBodies;

323	    for (let i = 0; i < bodies.length; i++) {
324	      paths.push(predictOrbit(i, bodies));
325	    }
326	    orbitPaths = paths;
327	    attractors = findAttractors(bodies);
328	  }

20)})`);\n\n      c.beginPath();\n      c.arc(sx, sy, vr, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n      c.fillStyle = discGrad;\n      c.fill();\n\n      // Gas giant horizontal bands (Jupiter-class and Saturn-class)\n      if (body.mass > 25000 && body.mass < 500000) {\n        c.save();\n        c.beginPath();\n        c.arc(sx, sy, vr, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n        c.clip();\n\n        const dk = (p: number) =>\n          `rgba(${Math.max(0, cr -
